tasks.title: MySQL 5.1.34 returns the result for dropped table.

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 大小写名称建删表后元数据查询残留有完整操作和一致性判据。

test_spec.setup: 独立库amit，Windows大小写不敏感文件系统；建CLSync等四个最小表。
test_spec.steps: 依次查询information_schema.tables，DROP四表，再用CLSync/clsync分别查询table_schema并SHOW TABLES。
test_spec.oracle: 删除成功后两种名称均无表记录；记录lower_case_table_names与排序规则排除不同对象。
test_spec.target_applicability: 8.0仍有同类信息架构查询和大小写配置，是否残留待测。

comments.author: Amit Bora
comments.text:
Description:
Hi,

I have created 4 tables in 'amit' database and then I deleted them. Still I able to get information about the table_schema for the table deleted.
After drop table when I fire a query for table_schema from information_schema.tables it will give me result as 'amit'. I didn't understand why it is happnes.

I am using MySQL version 5.1.34essential.
